answer: Locks are recorded in pulse, expire in oasis, and horizon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 83 aliases therefore needs 128 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2949 identities would post 3517 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
